comment: Checked-in floor on passing (SDK, fixture-or-scenario) cells for this repo's conformance jobs. rust-client is the fixture-mode column for this SDK's adapter (client role only; rust-server is all SKIP and never floor-checked, so it is omitted). go->rust is the pair matrix with ws-mixer-go (at goserver.pin, built with -tags conformance) as server and this SDK as client. The ws-mixer-spec runner at spec.pin v0.4.1 enforces a key only when the run produced rows for it and --fixture is left at "*". Each floor is the count actually observed passing; raise it as rows land and never lower it. At spec v0.4.1 both are at their targets: rust-client 24, go->rust 10.
